args.title: Fix parsing of amounts without leading zero
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The `parseAmount` function currently does not correctly parse amounts without a leading digit before the decimal point (e.g., `.75`). This behavior leads to such amounts being rejected. Update the validation regex to allow optional leading digits before the decimal point to fix this issue.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `parseAmount` function does not correctly handle amounts without a leading zero, such as `.75`. This behavior leads to these amounts being rejected as not a number. A fix in `src/util/money.ts` is proposed to adjust the validation regex to allow such amounts.
